weak: I was born in Alexandria, I studied commerce, I like football and music.
strong: I'm a data analyst with 5 years in reporting. Recently I automated a weekly report and saved 6 hours. I'm looking to grow into analytics engineering.
formula: Present, past, future. Current role, one proof point, why this job. Keep it under 60 seconds.

weak: I work too hard and I'm a perfectionist.
strong: I used to say yes to every request. Now I prioritise with my manager each Monday and my deadlines are met.
formula: Real weakness, what you did about it, the result. Never pick a core skill of the job.

weak: Because I need this job and I'm a hard worker.
strong: You need someone to cut reporting time. I did exactly that at my last job, from 2 days to 3 hours, and I can do it here.
formula: Their need, your proof, your result. Match your best story to their job post.

weak: My coworker was lazy so I did everything myself.
strong: We disagreed on a deadline. I listened, shared the data, and we agreed a split plan. We delivered on time.
formula: STAR: Situation, Task, Action, Result. Stay calm and never blame a person.

q: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
weak: Honestly, I haven't thought about it.
strong: Growing into a senior analyst who mentors others, and contributing to this team's goals while I learn.
formula: Show growth that fits the company, not a plan to leave. Be honest and specific.
